This incorrect assumption then dictated all subsequent search queries, leading the WebSurfer to look for a relationship between "John Doe" and the actual guest stars (Brian Doyle-Murray and Jonathan Katz), which naturally yielded no results because the premise was false. The correct path would have been to first identify the guest stars (which the WebSurfer did correctly in Step 1) and then search for their actual younger brothers (Bill Murray, in the case of Brian Doyle-Murray).
